title.narrative: Indonesia - Strategic Sector Cooperation in the Maritime Sector and IPR

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to support sustainable use of marine resources, a green transition of shipping, contribute to a safe and sustainable shipping environment and strengthen the framework conditions for the maritime sector in Indonesia through a strategic sector cooperation between the authorities in Indonesia and Denmark. All this is done by capacity building and sharing of best practices. The project is to improve Indonesia’s MSP capacity, to support a sustainable transition and improve green maritime practices, including strengthen the framework conditions for green shipping via policies and regulations. Lastly, the aim of the project is to sup-port and improve safety for seafarers and fishermen, and to sup-port safe ports in Indonesia. Furthermore, the aim is to strengthen the protection and enforce-ment of intellectual property rights (IPR) by capacity building and exchanges of best practises for the benefit of innovation and sus-tainable economic growth, including in the maritime sector.
